meta.title: Chat System: WebSocket gateways with cross-node routing

components.label: Sender client
components.explanation: Generates a client-side message id before sending, so a retried send is deduplicated by the server instead of creating a duplicate message.

components.label: Gateway node A
components.explanation: One of many stateless gateway nodes behind a load balancer. The socket layer is disposable; a dropped node is recovered by client replay from the last-seen message id.

components.label: Message service
components.explanation: Persists first, then attempts live delivery, then falls back to push. Persistence-before-delivery is the invariant that makes retries safe.

components.label: Message store
components.explanation: Wide-column store (Cassandra/ScyllaDB family), clustered by a time-sortable Snowflake/ULID id, which gives per-conversation ordering without a global sequence.

components.label: Connection registry
components.explanation: Redis or similar. Every write path checks it to find which gateway node holds the recipient's socket.

components.label: Recipient client
components.explanation: ACKs each message. Without an ACK before the timeout, the message is re-sent, or queued for reconnect or push.

components.label: Presence store
components.explanation: Refreshed by socket heartbeat. A missing heartbeat means offline; the key expires on its own, so no explicit offline event is needed.

cards.title: Delivery invariant
items: Persist, then deliver, then wait for ACK
Reconnect replays everything after the last-seen id

cards.title: Scaling
items: Large groups fan out async via a queue partitioned by group_id
